class.name: LuaScript
class.brief_description: Native Lua script resource attachable to Godot Node objects.
class.description: LuaScript stores Lua source, validates it with the embedded Lua runtime, and invokes supported Node lifecycle callbacks such as _enter_tree, _ready, _process, _physics_process, and _exit_tree. Lua scripts use the restricted Nexo API exposed by LuaRuntime.
